metadata.description: Median household income for Black or African American householders (ACS table B19013B), cividis navy (low) to gold (high). Measured over all 1,958 counties with a published value: 6 classes with breaks at $45k/$60k/$70k/$80k/$95k, which fall at the 49th/69th/79th/85th/92nd percentile of the national distribution. Shares its breaks and ramp with the white non-Hispanic style, so switching between the two shows the gap directly; the Census publishes this estimate only where the county's Black household count supports one. 39.47% have no published value and draw in neutral gray rather than as a low value. 21.09% of counties have a coefficient of variation above 0.3; this style does not fade them, so read median_hh_income_black_moe in the GeoParquet before drawing a conclusion from any single county.
